title: Structure-Based Design of Small-Molecule Inhibitors of Human Interleukin-6.
authors: Joshi, Ankit; Xiao, Zhousheng; Suman, Shreya; Cooper, Connor; Ha, Khanh; Carson, James A; Quarles, Leigh Darryl; Smith, Jeremy C; Gupta, Madhulika
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IL-6小分子抑制剂的结构设计，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Human Interleukin-6 (hIL-6) is a pro inflammatory cytokine that binds to its receptor, IL-6Ralpha followed by binding to gp130 and subsequent dimerization to form a hexamer signaling complex. As a critical inflammation mediator, hIL-6 is associated with a diverse range of diseases and monoclonal antibodies in clinical use that either target IL-6Ralpha or hIL-6 to inhibit signaling. Here, we perform high-throughput structure-based computational screening using ensemble docking for small-molecule antagonists for which the target conformations were taken from 600 ns long molecular dynamics simulations of the apo protein. Prior knowledge of the contact sites from binary complex studies and experimental work was incorporated into the docking studies. The top 20 scoring ligands from the in silico studies after post analysis were subjected to in vitro functional assays. Among these compounds, the ligand with the second-highest calculated binding affinity experimentally showed an ~84% inhibitory effect on IL6-induced STAT3 reporter activity at 10 muM concentration. This finding may pave the way for designing small-molecule inhibitors of hIL-6 of therapeutic significance.
abstract_zh: 人白细胞介素-6（hIL-6）是一种促炎细胞因子，与其受体IL-6Rα结合后，再与gp130结合并随后二聚化，形成六聚体信号传导复合物。作为关键的炎症介质，hIL-6与多种疾病相关，临床使用的单克隆抗体或靶向IL-6Rα或hIL-6以抑制信号传导。在此，我们利用集合对接（ensemble docking）进行基于结构的高通量计算筛选，针对小分子拮抗剂，其靶标构象取自600纳秒长的脱辅基蛋白分子动力学模拟。来自二元复合物研究和实验工作的接触位点先验知识被纳入对接研究中。经过后分析，从计算机模拟研究中的前20个评分配体进行了体外功能测定。在这些化合物中，计算结合亲和力第二高的配体在10μM浓度下，实验显示对IL-6诱导的STAT3报告基因活性具有约84%的抑制效果。这一发现可能为设计具有治疗意义的小分子hIL-6抑制剂铺平道路。
